npcRoster.publicDescription: Pykeman Redgallery is a Verdan painter whose refined manners, crimson canvases, and selective violence make polite society unsure whether to condemn him or commission him. He targets predators, raiders, and people he considers worse than monsters, turning their deaths into warnings disguised as art. Pykeman is not safe, not sane in any simple way, and not entirely wrong about the hypocrisy of officials who object to murder only when it is aesthetically difficult to ignore.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Glysera is a Town in Vuelmora, under Cooperative Commonwealth, with low danger, Farming, Partial forest, Grassland terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Verdan reads through the Verdan entry of the race compendium, within Orcs, Goblins, and Goblinoid Kin, marked by Enkirael. Fey-transformed humanoids who rapidly adapt physically and mentally as they age. They are resilient survivors with an unusually optimistic perspective on change. Table cues: +1 Constitution, +2 Charisma, Black Blood Healing, Limited Telepathy; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Neutral.
publicRumors: Pykeman's gallery smells of oil paint, iron, and justice gone feral.
Several criminals fear his signature more than the city watch.

npcRoster.name: Sheff of the Empty Cup
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Sheff of the Empty Cup is a shaky but sweet-natured Sea Elf drifter trying to rebuild their life after years of dependence on cheap diluted ichor tonics nearly ruined them. Their fixation has shifted onto Kelp-Kola, a fizzy caffeinated drink made from kelp, sugar, mineral salts, and coastal herbs, which they treat like a miracle cure, comfort object, and personal religion all at once. Sea elves in Belavadös are ocean-adapted people tied to reef culture, aquatic survival, and seafaring communities, which fits Sheff’s water-hauling work and nervous familiarity with canals, cisterns, and shoreline errands.
At the Thyravéa-Morn Guild Desk, Sheff runs water errands, carries messages, helps stock boarding houses, and rambles endlessly about Kelp-Kola flavors, bottle shapes, carbonation strength, and “proper drinking temperature.” They are awkward, lonely, overly grateful for small kindnesses, and more perceptive than people assume; the Freeblade Veil keep them close because a reliable bed, honest work, and one cold bottle can sometimes save a life better than any sermon. Thyravéa-Morn is one of Vuelmora’s towns, and Vuelmora is treated as a plains province with deep-cavern and subterranean settlement layers, giving Sheff plenty of uneasy routes, water stores, and settlement errands to navigate.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Thyravéa-Morn is a Town in Vuelmora, under Cooperative Commonwealth, with low danger, Farming, Partial forest, Grassland terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Sea Elf reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — Sea Elf. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
publicRumors: Sheff of the Empty Cup knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Nebday.
Sheff of the Empty Cup has a contact in Loxvire who will deny everything.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.

provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Vuelmora occupies 6,814,295.07 sq mi / 17,648,943.22 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 3.460130% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Grassland and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming and Partial forest.
